content.query:
SELECT
    TAR.TREC AS [Trade Agreement Recepient],
    CS.TX40 AS [Recepient Name],
    TAR.FVDT AS [Receipient Valid From Date],
    TAR.TVDT AS [Recepient Valid To Date],
    COALESCE(TAR.TAGN, TAH.TAGN) AS [Trade Agreement Number],
    TAR.RATE AS [Rate],
    TAH.TX40 AS [Trade Agreement Description],
    TAH.TX15 AS [Trade Agreement Name],
    TAH.TBST AS [Trade Agreement Status],
    TAH.STDE AS [Trade Agreement Valid From Date],
    TAH.LVDT AS [Trade Agreement Valid To Date],
    CASE WHEN TAR.TREC IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS [Recepient Y/N]
FROM M3.OBTREC TAR
FULL JOIN M3.OBTRAG TAH ON TAR.TAGN = TAH.TAGN
LEFT JOIN M3.CSYTAB CS ON TAR.TREC = CS.STKY AND CS.STCO = 'SMCD'
ORDER BY COALESCE(TAR.TAGN, TAH.TAGN)
